acceptanceCriteria: A range where a non-merge code or docs commit adds no HISTORY entry blocks core/history-entry
A range where every such commit adds its entry, or the extra commit is deps-only or a merge, passes
diagnosis: Reproduced: ci verify over a two-commit range where only the first commit adds a HISTORY entry passes. Root cause: ci.ts judges the range as one union scope, so historyEntryReal sees a docs/HISTORY/ file anywhere in the union and exempts everything; no code lists the range's commits against their own files. SPEC 4.9.3 says L4 requires every non-merge commit in range to add one. Fix: a per-commit check over rangeCommits in a new cli/ci-history.ts, merge and deps-shaped commits exempt like the L3 gate.

failing: [§4.9.3 EC-9] a code commit with no HISTORY file is flagged
[§4.9.3 EC-9] a commit whose files cannot be read fails closed
